purpose: Bind the trader-confirmed distinction between ordinary momentum, true displacement, rejection-trigger sequences, normal post-break continuation, 15m three-bar continuation after a weak break, and the only two permitted pre-break early-entry families.

momentum_vs_displacement.momentum_candle: Directional body/control candle using the existing frozen Params.body_frac and Params.close_loc geometry. Range expansion is NOT required.
momentum_vs_displacement.displacement: Momentum plus true range expansion using the existing frozen Params.range_ratio. Every strong bullish/red momentum candle is not displacement.

rejection_entry_family.trigger: a distinct momentum candle after the completed rejection/control event

normal_breakout_family.entry_trigger: the next completed 5m candle is directional momentum in the breakout direction and remains beyond the broken zone

weak_break_three_bar_continuation.weak_break_definition: The first completed breakout candle closes beyond the exact zone but does not meet the frozen momentum-candle geometry.
weak_break_three_bar_continuation.strong_first_break_behavior: Do not arm the weak-break 15m path; wait for the normal subsequent momentum confirmation.
sequence: BAR1: completed weak candle establishes the break beyond the exact key zone
BAR2: controlled pullback toward the broken level without invalidating through the opposite side
BAR3: directional momentum resumes and re-establishes continuation beyond the broken level
weak_break_three_bar_continuation.use_case: When the initial break is not a strong/momentum move, do not chase. Let price pull back and use the 15m three-bar continuation structure as an entry path.

families.name: REPEAT_TEST_MOMENTUM_ATTACK
families.rule: The key level has already been tested, at least one completed bar resets away so this is a distinct test rather than adjacent bars sitting on the level, then price returns for another test/attack and a momentum candle confirms the breakout attack before a completed candle has printed beyond the zone.

families.name: DISPLACEMENT_SEQUENCE_INTO_LEVEL
families.rule: A genuine displacement drive heads directly toward the key zone. At least one of the first two drive candles must be true displacement; the other may be ordinary directional momentum because every strong candle is not displacement. The THIRD candle is the timing trigger and must retain directional momentum while price is close to the authorized key level. If the third candle reverses color/control, no early entry.
families.note: A three-candle sequence may incidentally form an FVG, but the trader does not use FVG formation to authorize this entry. The rule is about the third candle of the displacement drive retaining momentum near the key level.

range_day_key_zone_room.rule: When the causal pre-open structure is ranging/mixed, do not authorize key zones crowded against or inside the active range. Preserve meaningful nearby structure as reaction/target context, but fresh entry-authorized zones should leave breakout travel room from the range edge before price reaches the key zone.
range_day_key_zone_room.range_classifier: existing causal premarket plan pm_structure == MIXED
range_day_key_zone_room.room_requirement: reuse existing frozen Params.min_room_r * Params.stop; no new numeric threshold

target_rule_reconfirmed.rule: First meaningful reaction area in physical trade direction owns TP. Liquidity cluster before FVG -> liquidity cluster wins. FVG before liquidity cluster -> FVG wins.
